title: Flow Engine Service Catalog (v1)
description: A catalog of services to analyze together (microservices / multi-repo).

path.description: Path to the service root (relative to the catalog file or absolute). Must contain flow-engine.json.

hostnames.description: Docker hostnames or aliases that map to this service (used for HTTP edge resolution).

composeFiles.description: Optional explicit compose files for this service when autodiscovery is insufficient.

dockerfiles.description: Optional explicit Dockerfile paths for this service.

envFiles.description: Optional explicit env files associated with this service.

serviceNames.description: Optional Docker Compose service names that should be mapped to this catalog service.
